decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Dagger with a short leaf-shaped double-edge blade, a brass crossguard with ball terminals, a ribbed tan grip and a rounded brass pommel with a pink cabochon on both faces. The blade has a real central ridge visible in the end-on views and closes to a point. Materials score 4 for the flat stylised steel. Free-standing weapon, unrigged.
limitations: Stylised palette rather than photoreal metal.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Katana with a correctly curved single-edge blade, a round brass tsuba, a pale cord-wrapped tsuka with a visible diamond wrap pattern and a brass kashira cap. The curvature is consistent in the top and side views and the wrap pattern continues around the grip. Materials score 4 because the hamon and steel are represented by flat colour rather than a layered shader. Free-standing weapon, unrigged.
limitations: The blade is fused to the hilt and cannot be drawn or separated.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Rejected on usability, not rights. The upstream model is a wall/floor display piece: the pike with langets is welded to a wide circular wooden floor plinth. The GLB contains a single mesh with a single material and no separate node for the furniture, so the stand cannot be hidden, deleted or unparented without destructive mesh surgery. The bottom view is entirely the stand. A weapon that cannot be separated from its plinth cannot be equipped, holstered or held by a character, which is the primary use for this category. The sculpt and materials themselves are clean.

All 12 views inspected. Child with curly auburn hair, a yellow hooded raincoat with a storm flap and pockets, a teal striped tee, rolled-cuff jeans, coral rain boots with modelled tread and a teal backpack with buckled straps. The hood is closed geometry with a visible lining, the backpack straps wrap correctly over both shoulders in the rear views, and the boot soles carry a real tread pattern in the bottom view. Rigged: 54-bone humanoid armature (24 body + 30 finger bones), walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
The backpack is fused to the torso and cannot be removed.
The hood is modelled in the down position only.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Articulated wooden artist's mannequin with a pale lacquered body, darker wood ball joints at the shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles, a separate head ovoid, a segmented torso and shaped hands and feet. Every ball joint is real geometry with a visible gap rather than a painted circle, and the joints read correctly from all eight orbits. Style fit is 4 because it is a plain reference figure by design rather than a detailed character. Rigged: 54-bone humanoid armature (24 body + 30 finger bones), walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
The mannequin is rigged with the standard humanoid skeleton, so its ball joints are driven by bones rather than being separate props.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Norse warrior with a plaited copper beard and moustache, iron nasal helm, layered fur pauldrons, studded leather cuirass with a round bronze brooch, green embroidered under-tunic, wrapped bracers, fur-cuffed trousers and laced boots. Back views confirm a round shield with a raised dragon relief and a bearded axe slung across it; the fur, stud rows and tunic hem continue correctly around the body. Top and bottom views are closed. Rigged: 54-bone humanoid armature (24 body + 30 finger bones), walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
The axe and shield are fused to the body mesh and cannot be detached or swapped.
Fur is modelled shell geometry, not groomed hair or a simulation.
